# Features

Goobster is one program made of optional features. This page lists each one: what it is, what it depends on, what it owns, and which keys and system tools it needs. It is generated from the feature catalog, so the names here match the code.

**Whether a feature is available is a fact about one installation, not about this file.** A host can leave a feature out, turn it off, or leave it waiting on a dependency or a missing tool. The portal shows that state where it matters: unavailable rooms leave the navigation, the Tools page marks an unavailable tool and says why, and guided tours for an unavailable feature are listed as unavailable. When Goobster reads his own documentation, a document about an unavailable feature is annotated with a one-line "not available on this installation" note. A document is never hidden for being unavailable, because it still explains how to enable the feature. How the state is decided and stored is described in [feature_state.md](feature_state.md); what each surface belongs to is in [feature_inventory.md](feature_inventory.md).

See [configuration.md](configuration.md) for every config key and environment variable, [configuration_guide.md](configuration_guide.md) for a walkthrough, and [commands.md](commands.md) for the slash commands.

## Core

Feature id: `core`. Chat, the portal shell and operator pages, settings, privacy, export, retention, the Inbox and the feature-state read path. Always available; never installable or disableable.

- **Kind:** always available
- **Depends on:** nothing
- **Owns:** 38 slash commands; 20 chat tools (`consultDocs`, `echoMessage`, `executePlan`, `fetchWebFile`, `findImages`, `forgetFact`, `generateImage`, `lookupNotes`, `manageAutomations`, `manageParlor`, `performSearch`, `readNotionPage`, `rememberFact`, `saveArtifact`, `scheduleFollowUp`, `searchNotion`, `showSavedFiles`, `trackAttention`, `watchFor`, `web_search`); 7 MCP tools (`get_inbox_item`, `list_docs`, `list_facts`, `list_inbox`, `read_doc`, `search_docs`, `search_memories`); 12 portal rooms (`activity`, `chat`, `decks`, `discussions`, `docs`, `home`, `host`, `people`, `settings`, `share`, `tools`, `usage`); 13 guided tours; 13 portal route groups; 1 WebSocket path (`/api/app/parlor/live`)
- **System dependencies:** `ollama`, `sharp`, `sqlite-vec`
- **Documentation:** [architecture.md](architecture.md), [feature_inventory.md](feature_inventory.md)
- **Reference:** [configuration.md](configuration.md) for every key, [commands.md](commands.md) for the commands.

## Discord

Feature id: `discord`. The Discord gateway adapter: slash commands, message routing, voice channels and DM delivery. The portal, schedulers and the Inbox keep working with it switched off.

- **Kind:** adapter
- **Fresh install default:** on
- **Depends on:** nothing
- **Owns:** 1 chat tool (`setNickname`); 3 portal route groups
- **Switch today:** `discord.enabled` or `GOOBSTER_DISCORD_ENABLED`, default on.
- **Host override:** `GOOBSTER_FEATURE_DISCORD=0` turns it off for one process; `data/features.json` records the installation's choice (see [feature_state.md](feature_state.md)).
- **Config keys:** `token`, `clientId`, `guildIds`, `discord.enabled`
- **Documentation:** [discord_setup.md](discord_setup.md), [independent_runtime.md](independent_runtime.md)
- **Provider help:** <https://discord.com/developers/applications>
- **Reference:** [configuration.md](configuration.md) for every key, [commands.md](commands.md) for the commands.

## Web Push

Feature id: `push`. Browser push notifications for the portal PWA. A VAPID key pair is generated and kept under data/ when none is configured.

- **Kind:** adapter
- **Fresh install default:** on
- **Depends on:** nothing
- **Owns:** 1 portal route group
- **Switch today:** `webapp.push.enabled` or `GOOBSTER_WEB_PUSH_ENABLED`, default on.
- **Host override:** `GOOBSTER_FEATURE_PUSH=0` turns it off for one process; `data/features.json` records the installation's choice (see [feature_state.md](feature_state.md)).
- **Credentials:**
  - `GOOBSTER_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY` / `webapp.push.vapidPublicKey` (optional): Public half of the VAPID key pair; generated automatically when absent.
  - `GOOBSTER_VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY` / `webapp.push.vapidPrivateKey` (optional): Private half of the VAPID key pair; must be set together with the public key.
  - `GOOBSTER_VAPID_SUBJECT` / `webapp.push.subject` (optional): Contact for push services: a mailto: address or an https URL.
- **Config keys:** `webapp.push.enabled`, `webapp.publicUrl`
- **System dependencies:** `web-push`
- **Documentation:** [pwa.md](pwa.md)
- **Reference:** [configuration.md](configuration.md) for every key, [commands.md](commands.md) for the commands.

## Mail

Feature id: `mail`. Outbound transactional mail (SMTP or Resend) for verified recovery addresses and open registration. Optional: the operator recovery link never needs it.

- **Kind:** adapter
- **Fresh install default:** on
- **Depends on:** nothing
- **Owns:** No surfaces of its own.
- **Switch today:** `mail.provider` or `GOOBSTER_MAIL_PROVIDER`, default off.
- **Host override:** `GOOBSTER_FEATURE_MAIL=0` turns it off for one process; `data/features.json` records the installation's choice (see [feature_state.md](feature_state.md)).
- **Credentials:**
  - `GOOBSTER_MAIL_PROVIDER` / `mail.provider` (optional): smtp or resend; empty picks the first provider with credentials.
  - `GOOBSTER_MAIL_FROM` / `mail.from` (optional): Sender address, for example "Goobster <goobster@example.org>".
  - `GOOBSTER_SMTP_URL` / `mail.smtp.url` (optional): smtp:// or smtps:// URL; wins over the discrete SMTP fields.
  - `GOOBSTER_SMTP_HOST` / `mail.smtp.host` (optional): SMTP server host (with GOOBSTER_SMTP_PORT, GOOBSTER_SMTP_USER and GOOBSTER_SMTP_PASS).
  - `GOOBSTER_SMTP_USER` / `mail.smtp.user` (optional): SMTP account name.
  - `GOOBSTER_SMTP_PASS` / `mail.smtp.pass` (optional): SMTP account password.
  - `RESEND_API_KEY` / `mail.resend.apiKey` (optional): Resend HTTP API key, for hosts whose network blocks outbound SMTP.
- **Config keys:** `mail.provider`, `mail.from`, `mail.replyTo`, `mail.smtp.port`, `mail.smtp.secure`
- **System dependencies:** `nodemailer`
- **Documentation:** [identity.md](identity.md)
- **Reference:** [configuration.md](configuration.md) for every key, [commands.md](commands.md) for the commands.

## Music

Feature id: `music`. Music Lab and Song Studio, music and ambience generation, the library and downloads. Discord playback additionally needs Voice and Discord.

- **Kind:** feature
- **Fresh install default:** on
- **Depends on:** nothing
- **Owns:** 13 slash commands; 1 context-menu command; 1 chat tool (`playTrack`); 1 portal room (`music`); 9 guided tours; 3 portal route groups; 1 WebSocket path (`/api/app/studio/live`)
- **Host override:** `GOOBSTER_FEATURE_MUSIC=0` turns it off for one process; `data/features.json` records the installation's choice (see [feature_state.md](feature_state.md)).
- **Credentials:**
  - `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` / `elevenlabs.apiKey` (optional): ElevenLabs Music and sound-effect generation; the rest of Music works without it.
  - `SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID` / `spotify.clientId` (optional): Spotify application id for spotdl track downloads (needs the secret as well).
  - `SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET` / `spotify.clientSecret` (optional): Spotify application secret for spotdl track downloads.
- **Config keys:** `spotdl.path`, `ytdlp.path`
- **System dependencies:** `python3-venv`, `spotdl`, `yt-dlp`
- **Documentation:** [music_lab.md](music_lab.md), [music_system.md](music_system.md)
- **Reference:** [configuration.md](configuration.md) for every key, [commands.md](commands.md) for the commands.

## Voice

Feature id: `voice`. Voice chat, text-to-speech, speech-to-text and live voice in Discord and the portal. Owns ffmpeg.

- **Kind:** feature
- **Fresh install default:** on
- **Depends on:** nothing
- **Owns:** 3 slash commands; 2 chat tools (`setSpeechAccent`, `speakMessage`); 3 portal route groups; 1 WebSocket path (`/api/app/voice/live`)
- **Host override:** `GOOBSTER_FEATURE_VOICE=0` turns it off for one process; `data/features.json` records the installation's choice (see [feature_state.md](feature_state.md)).
- **Credentials:**
  - `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` / `elevenlabs.apiKey` (optional): ElevenLabs text-to-speech and realtime transcription; without it the TTS commands report that the engine is not configured.
  - `ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID` / `elevenlabs.voiceId` (optional): Default voice for servers that have not chosen one.
- **Config keys:** `elevenlabs.modelId`
- **System dependencies:** `@discordjs/voice`, `ffmpeg` (required)

- **Fresh install default:** on
